name: Claymore
description: A massive two-handed blade that inspires all warriors to strike harder.

name: Spear
description: Extended reach for your warriors. Keep enemies at the tip.

name: Sword
description: A reliable blade that turns warriors into a cutting edge.

name: Shortbow
description: A light bow that lets rangers loose arrows with greater force.

name: Longbow
description: Rangers with a longbow can strike from distances that feel unfair.

name: Heavy Armor
description: Thick plate that soaks punishment. Slows nothing, stops everything.

name: Medium Armor
description: Flexible protection that keeps your troops responsive on the field.

name: Light Armor
description: Barely there. Your troops move like they are wearing nothing at all.

name: Ember Eye
description: A smoldering gem that sharpens the gaze of every unit in your warband.

name: Corrupted Clover
description: Lucky, in a wrong kind of way. Wrings more materials out of fallen enemies.

name: Healing Herbs
description: A bundle of bitter roots. Your troops start each battle a little sturdier.

name: Cat's Paw
description: Light-footed grace, bottled. Your whole warband moves with predatory ease. Made through alchemy, no cats were injured.

name: Frozen Meat
description: Pre-battle rations of questionable origin. Hits harder on a full stomach.

name: Golden Egg
description: Does not hatch. Does make enemies drop more gold when they die.

name: Prismatic Shrooms
description: Iridescent fungi that shift color with each spawn. Each unit that takes the field has a random stat boosted.

name: Command Banner
description: A rallying standard. For every full stack of morale, one more fighter joins the front line.

name: Marching Pack
description: Extra supplies mean room for more soldiers. Expands your warband capacity.
